name: Depakar Article Grid
author: depakar

sections.description:
Depakar Article Grid turns any page into a clean article grid. Visitors can search, sort, filter by category, year, or tag, and load more cards without a page reload.

It is built as a standalone plugin (not a page template), so you can drop it on any theme and control every label from wp-admin.

Place a grid

[depakar_article_grid]

Or insert the Depakar Article Grid block.

Typical setups

  • Blog listing: [depakar_article_grid exclude_categories="newsletter"]
  • Compact grid: [depakar_article_grid show_hero="0" show_cta="0"]
  • Saved shortcode profile: [depakar_article_grid id="blog-index"]

Admin control

Settings → Depakar Article Grid

  • Shortcodes: create as many section profiles as you need
  • Layout: post types, categories, tags, years, columns, cards per load
  • Text and labels: heading, search, sort, filters, empty states, CTA
  • Colors: accent, headings, cards, buttons, CTA bar
sections.installation:
1. Upload the depakar-article-grid folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Depakar Article Grid.
  3. Go to Settings → Depakar Article Grid and set your text and colors.
  4. Add [depakar_article_grid] to a page.
sections.faq:
Can I show blogs and newsletters separately?

Yes. Use include/exclude categories, or multiple shortcode profiles with different settings.

Does it work with custom post types?

Yes. Choose any public post types in the shortcode profile layout settings. You can select more than one.

Can I sell this plugin?

The code is GPL-2.0-or-later, which is required for WordPress. You may sell copies, support, and custom branding.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Renamed plugin-owned identifiers to the depaargr / DEPAARGR prefix.
  • Migrated legacy dag_* and plt_* options to depaargr_* keys.
  • Removed artificial profile, post type, and filter limits.
  • Added tag and year query constraints for profiles that use them.
  • Multiple custom shortcode profiles and multi post-type selection are available.

1.1.0

  • Renamed plugin package to Depakar Article Grid (folder, text domain, shortcode, and block).
  • Plugin Check fixes for prefixed template variables.

1.0.0

  • First release: shortcode, Gutenberg block, admin settings for layout, text, and colors.
